summary: End-to-end testing of new specialist self-service login feature. Backend (12/12 pytest) and Frontend (all 16 specified flows) PASS. Specialist login, read-only My Agenda, route protection, logout/session-clear, and Catalog access_code form/cards all work correctly.

backend.POST /api/auth/specialist-login (1001): PASS - returns Sofía Vargas with full object incl. access_code
backend.POST /api/auth/specialist-login (1001-10: PASS - all 4 codes return correct specialist names
backend.GET /api/specialists access_code field: PASS - all 4 seeded specialists carry correct codes 1001-1004

frontend./mi-agenda shows ONLY Sofia's appointmen: PASS - 3 appts (1 seeded TEST_, María González, Patricia López) all specialist_id=Sofia
frontend./mi-agenda has NO create/edit/delete/sta: PASS - no admin testids found, only my-logout-btn, my-view-day, my-view-week, my-week-prev/next
frontend.Logout from /mi-agenda clears session an: PASS (first run; second run flaky due to toast overlap but force-click works)
frontend.Catalog specialist modal has access_code: PASS - data-testid=specialist-access-code-input visible, accepts numeric only ('ab12cd34' -> '1234')
frontend.Catalog specialist cards display access_: PASS - 5 cards show CÓDIGO · 1001/1002/1003/1004 + new ones via specialist-code-{id}

critical_code_review_comments: MyAgenda.handleLogout race: clearSpecialist() then navigate('/') — observed flaky redirect to /especialista in one run because SpecialistProtected re-renders before navigation. Recommend navigate('/', {replace:true}) BEFORE clearSpecialist OR use useEffect to navigate when specialist becomes null. Functionally works in practice but is non-deterministic.
Specialist login input maxLength={6} but UI says '4 dígitos' and admin form maxLength={6} too — consider tightening to 4 to match UX copy.
PinLock has no specialist-access-btn for sub-1024px viewports? It's inside the right column which is shown on all sizes — verified OK.
Catalog uses native time picker (acceptable for time) and modal time inputs render the browser default which is consistent with project style.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seed (4 specialists with backfilled access_codes, 6 services, 5 appointments). One TEST_ specialist created/updated/deleted during pytest run. No leftover test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new specialist-login feature flows verified end-to-end. Note: a flaky logout->redirect (race) was observed; main agent may consider the small refactor noted above. Backend access_code seeding works because seed_data backfills by name when DB already has docs.
